name: Tayne
description: A man around forty in a black flat-brimmed hat, black sunglasses, a gold chain, a loud orange-gold and black baroque silk shirt, black leather trousers and boots, doing a wide-legged squat groove and a confident strut. An invented person.

nude.description: The same performer in a lime-green sling swimsuit (a mankini) with two stacked yellow swim rings (the top one has a rubber-duck head) hiding everything from the belly button to the upper thighs, still in the black hat, sunglasses, gold chain and boots. A silly beach costume, nothing explicit.
